scientific_intent.scientific_task: Apply a fixed centered affine inverse warp with bilinear image resampling.
scientific_intent.mathematical_operation: Inverse 2x2 affine map, four-tap interpolation, border fallback and UInt16 output truncation.
scientific_intent.discretization_or_topology: 512x512 image lattice with transformed four-neighbor gather. No PDE solve.
invariants: Uniform interior data remain uniform under normalized bilinear weights before quantization.
Out-of-range source coordinates retain source-defined background value 1.
accuracy_requirements: Full image tolerance one grayscale integer unit; lossless UInt16-to-Int32 artifacts outside timing.
scientific_intent.precision_sensitivity: Float32 coordinate/floor calculations can change gather neighborhoods; interpolation truncation can shift quantized pixels by one unit.
scientific_intent.input_size_regimes: 512x512 synthetic signed-coordinate gradient 3*x+5*y, ten repeats; source image-file workloads not newly measured.
scientific_intent.community_use_case: Geometric image resampling primitive. Source consumes raw unsigned-short images; a clinical application is not established.
scientific_intent.uncertainty: No measured registration/image-quality or medical-error metric; source gradients are a controlled fixture.
scientific_intent.review_phase: retrospective source annotation, no new GPU runs
